app.name: Remote CX Review
app.short_description: Review and approve automated CX decisions on the current ticket
app.long_description: Shows what the CX automation decided about this ticket, the flags that drove the decision, and — for cases routed to human review — one-click approve or decline. Every decision is written to the append-only audit log.
app.installation_instructions: Set 'apiBaseUrl' to a URL where the review API (src/review/server.js) is reachable. The other 'ucNNApiBaseUrl' settings are optional — set them only if those use cases' APIs are also deployed. Set 'cxSharedSecret' to the same value as ZAF_SHARED_SECRET on those APIs to have approve/decline requests cryptographically signed; leave it blank only for a local demo.

apiBaseUrl.label: Review API base URL
apiBaseUrl.helpText: Base URL of the review API, e.g. https://cx-review.example.com

uc06ApiBaseUrl.label: UC-06 amendments API base URL (optional)
uc06ApiBaseUrl.helpText: Base URL of the UC-06 dual-approval API. Leave blank if UC-06 isn't deployed yet.

uc08ApiBaseUrl.label: UC-08 dossiers API base URL (optional)
uc08ApiBaseUrl.helpText: Base URL of the UC-08 read-only dossiers API. Leave blank if UC-08 isn't deployed yet.

uc02ApiBaseUrl.label: UC-02 expenses API base URL (optional)
uc02ApiBaseUrl.helpText: Base URL of the UC-02 expense & receipt validation API. Leave blank if UC-02 isn't deployed yet.

uc03ApiBaseUrl.label: UC-03 travel/workation API base URL (optional)
uc03ApiBaseUrl.helpText: Base URL of the UC-03 travel support router API. Leave blank if UC-03 isn't deployed yet.

uc04ApiBaseUrl.label: UC-04 work authorization API base URL (optional)
uc04ApiBaseUrl.helpText: Base URL of the UC-04 work authorization API. Leave blank if UC-04 isn't deployed yet.

uc05ApiBaseUrl.label: UC-05 resignation notice API base URL (optional)
uc05ApiBaseUrl.helpText: Base URL of the UC-05 resignation notice API. Leave blank if UC-05 isn't deployed yet.

uc07ApiBaseUrl.label: UC-07 mobility dossiers API base URL (optional)
uc07ApiBaseUrl.helpText: Base URL of the UC-07 read-only global mobility dossiers API. Leave blank if UC-07 isn't deployed yet.

uc09ApiBaseUrl.label: UC-09 payroll adjustment API base URL (optional)
uc09ApiBaseUrl.helpText: Base URL of the UC-09 off-cycle payroll adjustment API. Leave blank if UC-09 isn't deployed yet.

cxSharedSecret.label: Signed-request shared secret (optional)
cxSharedSecret.helpText: The HS256 secret this app signs its requests with — reads as well as approve/decline. Must match ZAF_SHARED_SECRET on the API. Stored securely by Zendesk and never sent to the browser. Leave blank for a local demo.

signWrites.label: Sign requests to the automation APIs
signWrites.helpText: Tick this after saving the shared secret above. Zendesk never sends a secure setting to the browser, so the app cannot see that the secret is set — this checkbox is how it is told to use it. It applies to reads as well as approvals: a deployed API requires a signed identity before it will return a case. Leave unticked only for a local demo.
